caseStudies.headline: From 6-week manual order cycles to real-time retail partner sync
caseStudies.whatWeBuilt: MuleSoft integration layer between SAP ERP and Salesforce — automated purchase order and inventory sync across 200+ retail partners. Eliminated manual EDI workarounds and cross-system reconciliation that required four people and a shared spreadsheet.
caseStudies.outcome: 74% reduction in order processing time. Finance ops recovered 12+ hours per week. New partners onboarded in days, not weeks.
caseStudies.aiAngle: In Year 2, an AI agent monitors retail partner portals for demand signals and auto-flags reorder thresholds — surfaced every morning before the supply chain team opens their queue. The integration data layer built in Year 1 is exactly what the model reads.

caseStudies.headline: Freight billing automated — the 48-hour dispatch-to-invoice relay eliminated
caseStudies.whatWeBuilt: MuleSoft orchestration between Oracle ERP and Salesforce CRM — billing triggers automated from dispatch close events, real-time shipment status pushed to the customer portal. No manual handoffs between operations and finance.
caseStudies.outcome: 48-hour billing lag reduced to under 2 hours. Customer support tickets dropped 31%. Finance team stopped running daily reconciliation reports.
caseStudies.aiAngle: In Year 2, an agent surfaces at-risk shipments — delay flagged with no outbound customer contact in 24 hours — every morning. The operations team responds to a short exception list, not a monitoring dashboard.

caseStudies.headline: Matter open to invoiced in 30 minutes — closed the billing blind spot between Salesforce and NetSuite
caseStudies.whatWeBuilt: MuleSoft connecting Salesforce matter records to NetSuite billing — invoice creation triggered automatically on matter open. Payment status and billing health syncs back to Salesforce so relationship partners see the full picture without running NetSuite reports.
caseStudies.outcome: Invoice lag dropped from 3 days to under 30 minutes. Finance ops recovered 15 hours per week. Zero manual reconciliations at month-end.
caseStudies.aiAngle: In Year 2, a weekly agent cross-references open matters against NetSuite billing records — flags any matter with no invoice after 45 days, before partners notice. Finance reviews the exception list, not the spreadsheet.
